title: Missing Boy’s Mom Doesn’t Realize Her Shoes Are Bloody
description:
Bodycam footage shows a Washington mom calmly telling police what allegedly happened to her missing four-year-old son. Officers believed Janet Garcia’s story seemed suspicious and spotted blood on her shoes before taking her into custody. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
